title: Maximal-rank locally free kernel criterion on any scheme
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], $d:M\to N$ a structure-sheaf module morphism, and $M\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus s}$, $N\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. For natural numbers $s,n,r$ with $s\le r$, the kernel of $d$ is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] if and only if $d=0$ and either $s=r$ or $X$ is empty.

source.place: local matrix argument using Tag 0EWY; strict rank by the rank inequality

proof.text: Use the rank-r kernel trivializing open cover. Restriction preserves kernels, so the restricted kernel inclusion is monomorphic. Restrict the supplied finite free frames to obtain a monomorphic map from a free rank-r sheaf to a free rank-s sheaf on each chart.

When s=r, the inclusion gives an injective square matrix on global sections. Matrix.linearIndependent_col_iff_row and Matrix.vecMul_injective_iff make the transpose injective. Every row of the outgoing matrix annihilates the inclusion, hence is zero. Matrix injectivity then shows the restricted map is zero, and hom_eq_zero_of_restrict shows d=0.

When s<r, any point selects a chart whose global-section ring is nontrivial (a subsingleton ring would make the chart empty). LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective applied to the matrix map forces r<=s, contradicting s<r. Thus X is empty and d is zero.

Conversely, for d=0 and s=r the kernelZeroIsoSource and domain frame identify the kernel with a free rank-r sheaf. On an empty scheme the empty open cover establishes locally free rank r for any sheaf. All arguments include rank zero and empty schemes.

proof_origin.note: Fully proved in Lean from existing constructions and Mathlib; strict rank uses the injective free-module rank inequality.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocallyFree_kernel_maximalRank_iff
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf) (d : M ⟶ N)
    (s n r : ℕ) (hsr : s ≤ r)
    (hM : Nonempty (M ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (hN : Nonempty (N ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (kernel d) r ↔
      d = 0 ∧ (s = r ∨ IsEmpty X)
